notes.title: Custom Difficulty is Live! – V1.1.0 Update Log
notes.notes:
[h3]New Feature: “Taint” Custom Difficulty System
[/h3]
Dear Mekaa Adventurers,

Brace yourself for the V1.1.0 update with a custom difficulty system! We’ve [b]replaced the 20-level progression with this new system[/b]. It’s time to set your own rules! 

This new difficulty system has [b]24 options in total[/b]. Toggle on your desired options to add challenges to a run. Each option comes with a [b]“Taint” score[/b]. The higher sum it adds up to, the harder the game gets! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/bf196beb4485f8712ca72883dc870414586325f1.png[/img]

To smooth you into the new system, your highest level beaten from the old level progression will be translated into your starting Taint cap. The Taint sum of your selected options could not exceed that cap. To raise the Taint cap, you need to finish a run with max Taint. We can’t wait to find out who’ll be the first to beat [i][b]the ultimate 99 Taint[/b][/i]!

[b]Highest level beaten → Starting Taint cap
[/b]20 → 50
19 → 48
18 → 46
17 → 44
16 → 42
15 → 40
14 → 37
13 → 36
12 → 34
11 → 32
10 → 30
9 → 25
8 → 25
7 → 25
6 → 20
5 → 20
4 → 20
3 → 15
2 → 15
1 → 10
0 → 5

We have also updated the difficulty mode selection (Easy / Normal / Advanced) and placed it on the chapter selection screen. [b]The custom difficulty system is unlocked at Advanced Mode[/b], and you’ll be able to choose between these modes when you start a new run. 

[h3]Updated Feature: Camp Rewards
[/h3]
To accommodate the new difficulty system, changes have been made to the camp rewards as well. The 16 camps remain the same, but the rewards have been optimized. 

We made the camp rewards more consistent, so rewards from the same camp will grant the same type of perks, for example card removal. When you enter the later stages, you will find in the camp options the same camp that you have selected at the previous stage.

* Details of the new rewards can be found in camp information.

[h3]Other updates:
[/h3][list]
[*] Removed monster skills with a 30-second time limit.
[*] Rohan’s talent “Life Blessing” now increases his temporary max HP by 15% instead of 20%.
[*] Perry’s talent “Blood Displacement” now increases his strength by 5 instead of 6.
[*] Ranger talent “Swordster” now grants 12 block instead of 8.
[*] Fire buff now takes effect after all block-related buff take effect.
[/list]
[h3]The game will be 20% off from May 23 to May 30. Get a copy for yourself or your strategy-loving friend!
[/h3]

notes.title: Indies' Lies Full Release now!
notes.notes:
[h3]After a year in Early Access, Indies' Lies has left Early Access![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40652164/c6c5a822dd7f734cf18e56d05c501ab551f3cb63.png[/img]
[h3]Full Release Content Overview[/h3]
Dear Adventurers!

Finally! After 7 years in development and 1 year in Early Access We are moving to the Full Release!
Indies' Lies now officially offers the following new content：
✔️[i][b]Knights DLC with Rohan, Grace, and Perry to join the other 9 playable heroes[/b][/i]
✔️Reworked Rune System to enhance card modification depth
[b]-[/b] Now Runes can be attached to all cards, you can also attach up to 3 runes to one card.
[b]-[/b] Rework all 83 Rune Cards.
✔️[i][b]Reworked Class Cards for more complex synergy between buffs[/b][/i]
[b][i][u]Rework some Wizard Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We introduced the concept of "Even Psychic" to emphasize a more focused manipulation of Mekaa's witchcraft. We have also made builds based on Fire, Elements, View Cards, and Runes more powerful on a higher difficulty.
[b][i][u]Rework some Ranger Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We added a "Terminate" feature to display rangers' dexterity as they finish their attacks. At the same time, as rangers roam the Mekaa land with many skills, we enhanced synergies between builds with different features (such as Poison, Stab, and Thorn).
[b][i][u]Rework some Mechanists Cards[/u][/i][/b]
We added the concept of "Overload" to highlight that some old machinery is not fully developed (but can still be put to good use). We have also designed a new Auto experience with the new "Overload Scale", adding a "calculating" personality to the mechanists.

✔️[i][b]Reworked Talent System & enhanced many Talents[/b][/i]
Up to 120 talents have been optimized, with some new UI on the talent board and the maps. Some of the weaker talents have also been enhanced so that you have something to gain whenever you learn a new talent.

✔️[i][b]Added Special Battle Modes & Minigames[/b][/i]
You will encounter two "special battles" - Trial and Resentment on the map. We took inspiration from other games, such as a limited-time challenge with a huge flow of monsters in Hades, or Auto gameplay where the card sequence decides your results in Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game. These special battles will reward you with powerful artifacts that could boost you for the rest of the run!

✔️[i][b]Adjusted Difficulty according to feedback & Learning Curve[/b][/i]
With the above changes, the difficulty of the game has changed dramatically. It will be harder for beginners but easier to get better. We will continue to adjust the difficulty of the game based on your data - we hope that all players could have fun playing <Indies' Lies>!

[h3]DLC Knights will be free for 7 days after the Full Release![/h3]
To celebrate [b]Indies' Lies[/b] finally leaving Early Access, we decided to make the Knights DLC free for 7 days after the release. The DLC offers Rohan, Grace, and Perry as playable characters & allows you to dive into their stories.

[h3]Your feedback will make us very happy![/h3]
We appreciate your feedback! Share your thoughts here in the comments or leave a review on Steam. We welcome you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/GN4Dfq52AD]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/IndiesLies]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/IndiesLies]Facebook[/url].

[i]Thank you for staying with Indies' Lies![/i]

notes.title: V0.9.9 Beta Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Mekaa adventurers!  <Indies' Lies> V0.9.9 beta update is now available!


[b][h2]v0.9.8
[/h2][/b]
"Knight" beta is now closed (v0.9.7beta - knight)
- Game Save: Your story mode progress, secret card unlock progress and level progress will be synced to the released version (further progress will be prioritized)

[h2][b]v0.9.9
[/b][/h2]
New test beta "Test" (v0.9.9beta - test)
- Access: Switch to the "test" beta in properties - no access code is needed
- [b]Game Save: The progress of this beta is stored separately, and will NOT be synced to the released version[/b]
- Features: You won't be able to access Leaderboard or Mekaa's Journals. Scores won't be uploaded.
- Update: We will be updating and maintaining this beta so that more players could try out the new gameplay!


[h2][b]What's New in this Beta
[/b][/h2]
Overview: We've been developing and polishing the game for the past 4 months, with a goal to optimize the pace, strategy and balance of the game.  We've also added a few new features that we're experimenting with. Hope you'll enjoy them!

[b]- [Runes][/b]: Runes can now be attached to any card, and multiple runes can be attached to one card.

[b]- [Wizards][/b]: We introduced the concept of "Even Psychic" to emphasize a more focused manipulation of Mekaa's witchcraft. We have also made builds based on Fire, Elements, View Cards, and Runes more powerful on higher difficulty.

[b]- [Rangers][/b]: We added a "Terminate" feature to display rangers' dexterity as they finish their attacks. At the same time, as rangers roam the Mekaa land with many skills, we enhanced synergies between builds with different features (such as Poison, Stab and Thorn).

[b]- [Mechanists][/b]: We added the concept of "Overload" to highlight that some old machinery is not fully developed (but can still be put to good use). We have also designed a new Auto experience with the new "Overload Scale", adding a "calculating" personality to the mechanists.

[b]- [Talents][/b] Up to 120 talents have been optimised, with some new UI on the talent board and the maps. Some of the weaker talents have also been enhanced, so that you have something to gain whenever you learn a new talent.

[b]- [Special Battles] [/b]: You will encounter two "special battles" - Trial and Resentment on the map. We took inspirations from other games, such as a limited-time challenge with a huge flow of monsters in [i]Hades[/i], or an auto gameplay where the card sequence decides your results in [i]Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game[/i]. These special battles will reward you with powerful artifacts that could boost you for the rest of the run!

[b]-[Difficulty] [/b]With the above changes, the difficulty of the game has changed dramatically. It will be harder for beginners but easier to get better. We will continue to adjust the difficulty of the game based on your data - we hope that all players could have fun playing <Indies' Lies>!
